Name: Seasonal Immersion
Author: Entoarox
Description:
[color=#ff0000][b]This mod is no longer maintained.[/b][/color] You should use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] instead. Here's a list of Content Patcher equivalents for Seasonal Immersion packs (post a comment if there's any missing):

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2810]Cabin Replacement - Seasonal Vanilla[/url] — despite what the description says, this already uses Content Patcher. It doesn't require Seasonal Immersion.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1659]Dutch Farm Buildings[/url] — see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Eemie_Dutch_Farm_Buildings]unofficial conversion[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿ ﻿— updated for Content Patcher.

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1451]Seasonal Custom Farm Buildings[/url] — see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Custom_Farm_Buildings_.28Seasonal.29]unofficial conversion[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1502]Seasonal Foresty Farm Buildings[/url] — see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Seasonal_Foresty_Farm_Buildings]unofficial conversion[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1771]Seasonal Grandfather Clock[/url] — see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Seasonal_Gold_Clock]unofficial conversion[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/928]Seasonal Vanilla Buildings[/url] — see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Seasonal_Vanilla_Buildings]unofficial conversion[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891]Seasonal Victorian Buildings and Flowers[/url] — see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Using_XNB_mods#Eemie_Seasonal_Victorian_Buildings]unofficial conversion[/url].
[/list]

--------------------


[b]Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Download a content pack (see below).
[*][b]On Windows:[/b] copy the ContentPack.zip into the mod's folder.
[b]On Linux or Mac:[/b] unzip the ContentPack.zip into the mod's folder.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
Suggested content packs (you can only install one):
[list]
[*][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/attachments/contentpack-zip.168340]Hobbit House[/url] by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/lemonex.28207/]LemonEX[/url] (see [url=http://i.imgur.com/NrJm1IV.png]example[/url])
[*][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/resources/pans-seasonal-buildings.4310/download?version=19177]Lumisteria Houses[/url] by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/panwicker.673982/]Panwicker[/url] (see [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/pans-seasonal-houses.126329/#post-3053111]example[/url] or [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/196]credit[/url])
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]Elle's Seasonal Buildings[/url]﻿ by [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/junimods.733912/]junimods[/url] (see [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/elles-seasonal-non-seasonal-building-replacements.127106/]example and credit[/url])
[/list]

[b]Create a new content pack (for modders)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Create four folders under the mod's folder: spring, summer, fall, and winter.
[*]Add PNGs with the same name as the content to replace in each folder. For example, add Mill.png to override the Content/Buildings/Mill.xnb file.

You can do this for any file under Content/Buildings, TerrainFeatures/Flooring, and TileSheets/Craftables. For craftables only, you must specify Craftables_indoors.png or Craftables_outdoors.png (or both).
[*]Create a manifest.json file next to the season folders with this content (replace all-caps text with your not-all-caps information):
Code:
[code]
{
"Name": "MOD NAME HERE",
"Author": "AUTHOR NAME HERE",
"Version":"1.0.0",
"Description": "BRIEF DESCRIPTION HERE",
}
[/code]
[*]Optionally zip it into a ContentPack.zip folder (with the manifest.json and season folders at the root) to share.
[/list]

[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.2.33. (Not compatible with 1.3!)
[*]Not compatible with Linux/Mac.
[/list]
